references.text: John the Baptist also preaches repentance and the presence of the kingdom of heaven, which prepares the way for Jesus' message.
The prophet Hosea speaks of the return and repentance of Israel's children, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' call to repentance.
Micah prophesies about a ruler from Bethlehem, pointing forward to Jesus' message and his fulfillment of the prophecies.
Daniel's prophecy of an eternal kingdom can be viewed in light of Jesus' preaching on the nearness of the kingdom of heaven.
Luke tells of Jesus' call to repentance as a necessity for salvation, which resonates with the message in Matthew 4:17.
Peter's sermon on Pentecost contains a call to repentance that corresponds to Jesus' message about the nearness of the kingdom of heaven.
The Revelation of John calls for repentance to set right what is wrong, reflecting Jesus' exhortation in Matthew 4:17.
